shared_elements: tall vertical upright form carrying figures stacked in tiers
animal head/creature shown frontally or in profile with emphasized eyes
arms/hands rendered as thin curving elements against the body/surface
horizontal band of repeated geometric marks (zigzag/chevron row)
justification: Both surfaces stack creatures and small anthropomorphic figures in vertical tiers up a tall upright form, with schematic large-eyed, big-headed beings, thin curving arms laid against the surface, and a horizontal row of repeated chevron-like marks in the upper zone. The biggest difference is that A is a three-dimensional sequence of massive frontal heads (bared-teeth predator over a human face) while B is a flat relief panel populated by profile quadrupeds, birds and small figures with no equivalent giant frontal face.
